user.title: Harvest Right Login
user.description: Enter the email and password for your Harvest Right account — the same credentials you use in the Harvest Right app. Your freeze dryer must already be set up in that app and connected to Wi-Fi.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Harvest Right
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {email} has expired. Enter the password for this account to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Harvest Right servers. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_dryers: No freeze dryers were found on this account. Add your dryer in the Harvest Right app first, then retry.
error.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Harvest Right account than the one being re-authenticated.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the Home Assistant logs for details.

data.temperature_unit: Temperature unit reported by the dryer
data.scan_interval: How often to check for added or removed dryers

data_description.temperature_unit: Set this to match the unit your freeze dryer's display uses, so Home Assistant labels readings correctly.
data_description.scan_interval: In minutes. Live telemetry is always pushed instantly over MQTT; this only controls how often the dryer list itself is re-checked.

refresh.name: Refresh telemetry
refresh.description: Asks the freeze dryer(s) to send fresh telemetry immediately instead of waiting for the next periodic update.
